facts.label: Apresentação curta
facts.sub: Comece com Today I’m going to talk about… Use First e Then com I’ll + verbo. Fale devagar e termine com Thank you for listening.

facts.label: Começar
facts.sub: Para começar uma apresentação, sorria e diga Hello, everyone. Depois diga o tema: Today I’m going to talk about our new app. Um começo claro deixa a plateia calma.

facts.label: Plano
facts.sub: Mostre os passos com First e Then: First, I’ll say my name. Then I’ll show the slides. I’ll + verbo é a forma simples do futuro. Poucos pontos são melhores que muitos.

pages.title: An office in Dallas · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Tuesday morning in an office in Dallas. Chairs stand in rows in a meeting room. Ben holds a few cards with notes. His coworker Ora walks in with a smile. Ben looks at the clock. Ora asks if he is ready.
“Hi, Ben! Are you ready for your talk?” says Ora. “I’m a little nervous. I’m going to talk about our new app.” says Ben. “Don’t worry. Start with a smile and say hello.” says Ora.
